text:
sam_sales: Hey finance, need a quick deal-desk approval. Customer Bluewave Labs hit a usage spike (embeddings) and got INV-2024-256 for $32,450. They're asking for a one-time credit of $12,500 to smooth the onboarding in exchange for a 12‑month committed contract (ACV $120k). Can we approve? Context: evaluation traffic caused the spike, they say commit will prevent recurrence and they want start-of-year onboarding next week.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-256 created 2024-11-03, amount $32,450, status: paid. Invoice link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2024-256

anya_finance: thanks Sam — can you paste the expected ARR/ACV and margin impact if we grant $12.5k? need to size P&L hit and whether this sets a precedent.

sam_sales: ACV if they sign is $120k (committed), expected go-live Jan 1. Gross margin on hosted usage ~70% historically for this workload. Back-of-envelope: $12.5k credit ~10.4% of first-year ACV, gross margin loss ~3.1k.

kevin_revops: Proposed guardrails: make the credit contingent on 1) signed order within 7 days, 2) net-new commit of at least $100k, and 3) limit to a one-time customer-credit (no recurring credits). If customer misses signature window, reduce credit to $6k. I can enforce in SFDC and add a field.

lexi_legal: We'll need an amendment to the MSA that documents the credit and conditions (timebox + non-refundable once applied). I can draft a short amendment and circulate for countersign. Also recommend include a clause that future overages revert to standard pricing.

anya_finance: Approval matrix: if CFO signs off we can route for accounting. We prefer attaching a GL memo: CREDIT-BW-11-24, reason: onboarding concession -> conversion. Accounting impact: reduce recognized revenue for the period by $12,500 as a contra-revenue/credit note and track as sales promotion expense. Any objections?

matt_cfo: From a finance POV I can approve up to $15k one-time for conversion if ACV >= $100k and CAC payback <= 9 months. Here ACV $120k, so conditionally approve. Conditions: require signed order within 7 days, redlined amendment from Legal, and RevOps to set CRM tags for audit.

sam_sales: Got it — customer is ready to sign. I'll push for signature today and attach the contract note about the credit. Can Legal/RevOps stand by for a quick turnaround?

kevin_revops: I'll add the conditional credit field in SFDC and set a follow-up task for collection ops.

lexi_legal: I'll draft the amendment now and DM the redline to Sam. Expect draft in ~90 minutes.

anya_finance: Approved pending: (1) signed amendment within 7 days, (2) CRM tag by RevOps, (3) accounting code CREDIT-BW-11-24 used when issuing CN. I'll create the approval record.

matt_cfo: Approved ✅ contingent on the three items above.

billing-bot: Credit note CN-2024-078 created (pending contract confirmation) for $12,500 referencing INV-2024-256. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/credits/CN-2024-078

sam_sales: Perfect — I'll post the signed amendment here when it lands. Thanks everyone :tada:

kevin_revops: Noted. I'll also add a one-month churn-watch reminder after go-live.

lexi_legal: Draft sent to Sam (DM).

anya_finance: Recording this thread in the deal-desk log. Will attach the amendment and final credit note when complete.

sam_sales: Final status: customer signed at 2024-11-04 16:12 PST, amendment attached, billing please finalize CN.

billing-bot: CN-2024-078 finalized and applied to customer account on 2024-11-04.

anya_finance: Closing thread — credit applied and conditions met. Marking as approved in Deal Desk tracker. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
